_about: Phase 5 pilot tracker (blueprint: 8 videos in the chosen niche, alternate Kokoro and the owner's own voice; measure cost, time and failure rate per video). Topics = top 8 Phase 4 ideas (run 40533636460). Claude fills runs; the owner reports owner_minutes (recording + review + upload), upload date and YouTube video id. 27 Oct: owner chose NOT to record their voice for now, so all 8 use Kokoro; the Kokoro-vs-own-voice test is postponed (the own-voice tools stay ready).
